name: Lava Emitter
description: Spawns lava around the user when the weapon is used.

name: Green Crescent
description: Spin slash hurls a crescent of green energy that cuts through enemies in its path.

name: Fireball Fan
description: Every swing looses a fan of five fireballs.

name: Icicle Volley
description: Every strike fires five icicles.

name: Gleaming Projectile
description: Every swing releases a gleaming projectile that shatters incoming enemy bullets clearing a path through gunfire.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Calls a bolt of lightning down onto a marked target with a chance to stun. Not triggered every attack.

name: Arc Volley
description: First two hits of a three-hit combo each fire seven projectiles.

name: Triangular Volley
description: Third hit of a three-hit combo sprays thirteen bolts in a triangular volley.

name: Bouncing Bullets
description: Forward spin summons a skyward shockwave that looses four bouncing bullets.

name: Splitting Rounds
description: Follow-up thrust scatters three rounds that split into four shards on impact.

name: Penetrating Shockwave
description: Full charge fires a massive penetrating shockwave that deletes enemy projectiles as it travels.

name: Oil Emitter
description: Each swing leaves a slick of flammable oil — ignite it for a firestorm.

name: Aqua Font
description: Swings spray water, dousing flames and soaking the ground for freeze combos.

name: Miasma Vent
description: Belches a cloud of toxic gas with each swing, poisoning anything inside.

name: Frost Emitter
description: Lays a patch of ice underfoot — slick footing that chills the careless.

name: Sanguine Spray
description: Sprays blood across the floor, fuel for blood-soaked synergies.

name: Coal Seeder
description: Scatters lumps of flammable coal that smolder into lingering fire.

name: Dust Veil
description: Kicks up a concealing cloud of dust on every swing.

name: Venom Edge
description: Strikes coat foes in venom, poisoning them over time.

name: Soaking Strike
description: Blows leave enemies drenched, priming them for freezing or shock.

name: Greased Edge
description: Coats struck foes in oil — one spark sets them ablaze.

name: Frostbite Edge
description: Each hit saps warmth, chilling foes toward a deep freeze.

name: Ember Edge
description: Strikes ignite foes, setting them burning.

name: Rending Edge
description: Wounds bleed freely, leaving enemies bloody and weakened.

name: Sharpened
description: +3 flat damage to every hit.

name: Heavy Head
description: +5 damage, but swings land 25% slower.

name: Honed Point
description: +15% critical strike chance.

name: Executioner's Mark
description: Critical hits deal an extra +0.5x damage.

name: Quickdraw
description: Swings come 20% faster.

name: Long Reach
description: Extends weapon reach by 30%.

name: Wide Arc
description: Widens the swing arc by 40%, sweeping more foes.

name: Deep Cut
description: Carves 80% deeper into terrain — dig and tunnel with ease.

name: Fleetfoot
description: Move 15% faster while attacking.

name: Frostbreaker
description: Deal +60% damage to chilled or frozen foes.

name: Pyroclast
description: Deal +50% damage to burning foes.

name: Coup de Grace
description: +100% damage to foes below 30% health.

name: Bloodlust
description: Each kill grants stacking damage that fades when the killing stops.

name: Rampage
description: Consecutive hits ramp damage; missing resets the streak.

name: Glass Cannon
description: +80% damage while at full health; drops the moment you're hurt.

name: Vampiric
description: Heal a sliver of health on each kill.

name: Momentum
description: The faster you move, the harder you hit — up to +50%.

name: Adrenaline
description: Swings get faster as your health drops, up to 40% faster.

name: Combo Keeper
description: Every 5th hit is a guaranteed critical.

name: Homing Hex
description: Every swing looses a bolt that curves toward the nearest foe.

name: Chain Spark
description: Critical hits arc lightning to nearby enemies, with a chance to stun.

name: Ricochet Shard
description: Swings fling a shard that ricochets off walls, striking again.

name: Piercing Lance
description: Looses a lance that skewers every foe in a line.

name: Cluster Bomb
description: Hurls a bomb that bursts into a ring of fragments.

name: Boomerang Arc
description: Throws a blade-arc that returns, hitting foes both ways.

name: Spectral Echo
description: A ghostly copy repeats your swing a moment later.

name: Tunnel Borer
description: Swings blast a wide tunnel through soft terrain.

name: Shockwave Stomp
description: Each swing emits a shockwave that knocks foes back.

name: Magnet Field
description: Pulls loose gold and drops toward you on every swing.

name: Repulsor Nova
description: A full charge releases a nova that flings enemies away.

name: Concussive Edge
description: Hits have a chance to stun, briefly halting foes.

name: Midas Touch
description: Slain enemies spill extra gold.

name: Steam Burst
description: Striking a wet foe erupts in scalding steam, spreading the burn.
